responsibility: Serves as the master builtin-function definition table for the rs6000/powerpc backend. Through a macro-driven format, it enumerates Altivec, VSX, SPE, paired, HTM, and miscellaneous builtins, recording each builtin’s public name, option-mask enable conditions, attribute flags, and implementing insn code or special-case classification; other backend code includes this file with different macro definitions to generate enums, declaration tables, type/attribute metadata, and dispatch structures from a single source of truth.
